verdict.summary: Anchoring remains structurally mature and well documented, with both CLI and verify-service Vitest suites passing, but RC confidence is reduced by unresolved high-severity dependency findings, source/OpenAPI route drift, a documented-port runtime that does not mirror the current source tree, branch/registry drift, a dirty worktree, no exact release tag, and no configured Git remote/upstream.

Verify-service deterministic test passes: 1/1 file and 1/1 test.

The listener on port 8080 does not mirror current server.ts: /health lacks the current ts field and /batches is absent.
npm audit fails for both CLI and verify-service dependency trees with high-severity findings.
Registry default branch master disagrees with repository branch main.
The worktree contains one modified tracked file and three untracked files.
No exact Git tag identifies the assessed commit.
No origin remote or upstream is configured in the inspected local repository.
